Implementation Plan Implementation plan for issue #6792: resolve conflicted `.claude/hooks/*` files from their template twins, behind a flag that defaults off. **Scope summary** Hook-file conflicts on `.claude/hooks/*` currently fail closed with `sandbox_path_host_only`. This change lets `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh` resolve them without the model, by copying the cleanly merged `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/*` twin. It only runs when `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED=true`, and the default is `false` in both the workflow and the script, so merging changes nothing. Any hook that fails the eligibility checks keeps today's refusal, and no hook is ever sent to the model. Scope-mode: Hold Scope Reuse-audit: extends scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh manifest union-merge block (CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED pattern, its early-commit tail, and the `_run_live_union_block` test harness) Scope-mode justification: The issue and the binding clarification answers (Q1:A, Q2:A) fix the change set: the script, one env line in the workflow, tests, README and a changelog fragment, with heal intake and the scope guards untouched. The manifest union-merge block in the same script already does the same kind of work (deterministic resolution before the resolver, re-computing the allowlist, then an `[ai-merge-resolve]` commit when nothing else is unmerged). The new block sits next to it, copies its shape, and reuses its test harness instead of adding a new mechanism. Under the Boil the Lake rule, the full set of eligibility checks (stage shape, symlinked parent directories, twin regularity, divergence list, integration-sync exclusion) is only a few dozen lines more than a bare copy. Each check moves correctness and security forward (§6), so all of them are in scope. **Automation / scheduling (§20.E)** - No new script. This extends the existing `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`. - Entry point: the existing step "Prepare merge-conflict resolver prompt and pre-snapshot" in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (around line 5835). It runs on the existing review/autofix triggers when `MERGE_CONFLICT == 'true'`. No new trigger. - No long-running supervisor, no DB work, and no entry in `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`. **Planning ref** - The planning context recorded HEAD `b322f59c8d3580b66bbb71d9daf4024e0882bb84` on `main`. The checkout read during planning is `d6207482b64bb4187717998608f8aa4619cbbc68` on `main`, because `main` has moved since. - The issue has no integration-branch metadata, so no mismatch applies. The line numbers below come from `d620748`. **Prerequisite (operator setup, outside this plan)** - The issue body shown in the planning context has no `files_touched:` block. - Per Q1:A, a maintainer must add the exact grant listed under SETUP REQUIRED to the issue body and remove `ai:scope-blocked`. Without it, implement's automation-path guard refuses the commit again with `no_allowlist` (for `scripts/` and `.github/`). --- **1. Files likely to change** - `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`: add the new hook-template resolution block. - `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`: add one env line plus a short comment to the conflict-prepare step, right after line 5835. - The file is 473,485 bytes today and grows by about 300 bytes, still under the 480,000 guard. Check with `wc -c`. - `tests/test_conflict_manifest_union_contract.py`: regression tests. Extend `_run_live_union_block` with an optional `hook_enabled` keyword. - `README.md`: a new `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED` row directly after the `CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED` row (line 149). - `changelog.d/6772-conflict-hook-template-resolve.md`: new file, `` style as in `changelog.d/6755-*.md`. - Not changed: - `agents.md`: it has a `CONFLICT_MANIFEST_UNION_ENABLED` row at line 2405, but it is outside the grant. - `scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh`, `scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py`, heal intake, `scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py`. - `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`: read only. **2. Functions / modules to implement** In `scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh`, add a block: - **Placement:** after the manifest union-merge `if … fi` (ends around line 385) and before the comment `# When the allowlist is empty there is nothing for Codex to`. That keeps it inside the region the test helper `_union_block()` extracts, so the existing live harness runs it. - **Header comment:** explains why the twin is authoritative (`tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py` requires byte equality unless the file is on the divergence list), that the default is off, the integration-sync exclusion, and that every other case keeps the host-only refusal. Logic: a. **Flag check.** If `"${CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED:-false}" != "true"`, the block is a no-op. If any unmerged `.claude/hooks/` path exists, it emits one line, `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE outcome=skipped reason=disabled count=`, and changes nothing else. b. **Candidates.** Read entries of `${RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE}` matching `^\.claude/hooks/`. If there are none, it is a no-op. c. **Block-level refusals.** Each one logs `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE outcome=refused reason= count=` and leaves every candidate unmerged: - The branch class `${TARGET_BRANCH:-${HEAD_REF:-}}` matches `orchestrator/project-*` → `reason=integration_sync` (see D2). - The divergence list cannot be read from the merged index (`git show ":0:.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json"` fails because the file is missing or unmerged), or does not parse as JSON whose `divergent` is an object. → `reason=divergence_unreadable`. - Parse it with `PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 python3 -I -c …`, reading the blob from stdin. - Collect the keys that start with `hooks/`. d. **Per-path eligibility.** Every check below must pass; otherwise log `outcome=refused reason=` and leave the path unmerged. Logs use only fixed reason tokens, never untrusted path text, unless the path passed the name check in the first rule (the same discipline as `check-paths`). - The path matches `^\.claude/hooks/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$`, has no `..` or empty segment, and is not a directory → `unsafe_name`. - `git ls-files -u -s -- P` has both stage 2 and stage 3, each with mode `100644` or `100755` (stage 1 may be missing, the add/add case) → `stage_shape` / `non_regular`. Delete/modify, symlink (`120000`) and gitlink (`160000`) entries are refused. - No leading directory of P (`.claude`, `.claude/hooks`, and any nested directory) is a symlink in the worktree, and P itself is not a symlink → `symlinked_parent`. - T = `workflow-templates/` + P: - T must not be in the unmerged list (`twin_unmerged`). - `git ls-files -s -- T` must return exactly one stage-0 entry (`twin_missing`) with mode `100644` or `100755` (`twin_non_regular`). - The worktree T must be a regular non-symlink file (`[ -f ] && [ ! -L ]`) that matches the index (`git diff --quiet -- T`) → `twin_worktree_mismatch`. - `hooks/` must not be a divergence-list key → `divergent`. e. **Resolve an eligible path** from the twin's index entry, so the exact bytes and mode are copied with no shell copy (see D3): - Run `git rm -q --cached -- P` (drops stages 1–3), then `git update-index --add --cacheinfo ",,P"`, then `rm -f -- P`, then `git checkout-index -f -- P`. - Post-check: - `git ls-files -u -- P` is empty. - `git ls-files -s -- P` shows the twin's mode and blob. - `git hash-object -- P` equals the blob. - The worktree P is a non-symlink regular file. - If any post-check fails, print `::error::CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE outcome=failed reason=postcondition` and `exit 1`. This fails closed, as an unhandled manifest conflict does. - On success, log `outcome=resolved path=

mode=`. P passed the name check, so it is safe to print. f. **After resolving at least one path:** - Recompute `RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE` and `_resolver_allowlist_count` exactly as the manifest block does. - If the count is 0, run the same early-commit tail as the manifest block (lines 351–375). The tail is duplicated on purpose (see D1) and contains: - `git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch -- node_modules`; - the consumer-repo `git reset` / `git checkout` of protected directories when `IS_WORKFLOW_SOURCE_REPO != true`; - `git commit -m "[ai-merge-resolve] resolve merge conflicts"`; - stash restore, removing `${RESOLVE_STASH}` and `${_merge_stderr_file}`; - `echo "CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"`; - a message containing "Codex resolver will be skipped"; - `exit 0`. - `MERGE_CONFLICT` stays `true`, so the resolution commit is re-reviewed. - If the count is above 0, the remaining paths fall through to the existing resolver path unchanged. - Resolved hooks drop out of `CONFLICTED_PATHS_FILE`, which line 970 rebuilds from `git ls-files --unmerged`. - Refused hooks stay in the allowlist and reach `check-paths`, which produces the existing `sandbox_path_host_only` refusal. No model runs. `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`: add directly below line 5835: ``` # Off by default: deterministic resolution of conflicted .claude/hooks/* # files from their cleanly merged workflow-templates/ twin # (scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh). CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED: ${{ vars.CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE_ENABLED || 'false' }} ``` **3. Data structures affected** - No persisted state. - Runtime files: `RESOLVER_ALLOWLIST_FILE` is recomputed. `RESOLVER_INITIAL_UNMERGED_PATHS_FILE` is deliberately left unchanged, matching the manifest precedent. - New log prefix `CONFLICT_HOOK_TEMPLATE_RESOLVE` (additive; it is not added to the agents.md stable-prefix list because agents.md is outside the grant). **4.
